description: A painted scene of a marsh landscape under a dark, stormy sky with a low sunlit glow on the horizon. In the foreground, bare-chested and tunic-clad men carry bundles of reeds and stack mudbricks in a wall. A large arched, reed-thatched hut with a wooden frame stands on a rise beside the wall, with a man on a scaffold binding reeds to it. Small figures in reed boats and wading in channels fill the middle ground. No text, frame or border is visible.
